get_language('shell') resolves the alias to 'bash' and returns ok

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:tree_sitter_language_pack/tree_sitter_language_pack.dart';
import 'package:tree_sitter_language_pack/src/tree_sitter_language_pack_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final language = await TreeSitterLanguagePackBridge.getLanguage('shell');
    stdout.writeln(language);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
